sections.whatsHappening: You and the other parties must serve and file documents at different stages. At least 14 days before the settlement conference, each party shall serve on every other party and file with the court a copy of any document to be relied on at the trial, including an expert report, not attached to the party's claim or defence. You must also serve and file a list of proposed witnesses (Form 13A) and of other persons with knowledge of the matters in dispute. A document served at least 30 days before the trial date shall be received in evidence, unless the trial judge orders otherwise.
sections.whatToDoNext: Ensure you serve and file the required documents within the specified timeframes. You can serve the documents yourself, have someone else serve them for you, or arrange for a private process server. Make detailed notes of the service details for your affidavit of service.
sections.whatHappensAfter: After serving and filing the documents, they will be part of the court record. Documents served at least 30 days before the trial date will be received in evidence unless the trial judge decides otherwise. If you wish to cross-examine a witness or author of a document served on you, you may summon them as a witness.
